## v13.2.1

Fix sustained panel CPU spikes during node status polling on SQLite databases with large inbound client configurations.

Node status classification now joins the client attachment and traffic tables directly, using already loaded inbound-to-node metadata. This avoids repeatedly reading large inbound JSON records for each attachment, while preserving active, disabled and depleted client counts and node attribution. The same fix covers the node tree.

Validated with node and heartbeat regression tests under the race detector, a query-plan regression, and the affected server's database. A query over 19,784 attachments dropped from 7.16 seconds to under 0.1 seconds.
